about: The behavioural cases every adapter must pass (docs/adr/0039). `needs` are capabilities an agent declares in tests/conformance/agents/<key>.mjs (`caps`); a case whose need an agent lacks is not run there, and the case 'adapter.capabilities-are-what-the-adapter-says' checks each declared capability against the adapter's own exports, so a lack is never claimed without being true. A '!' negates a need; 'reminder:prompt' compares a value.

cases.behaviour: the session card is handed to the agent with what the project knows
an agent with no instructions file gets the Rule 0 block in the card
every hook answers a probe, so check finds a dead hook
the per-prompt reminder carries the ID the task will be recorded under
where the prompt hook cannot add context, the reminder rides on the first tool result
where the agent drops a prompt hook's output, no reminder is promised and the hook still runs
an L2 edit is denied until the user was asked in the choice window
the same edit passes once the window was answered
a shell command that changes files is gated like an edit
a command that changes nothing is never gated
Waymark's own memory is no project change
a turn routed Q that edits a file is sent back to be re-routed
a turn with no routing line has no level to gate
where no hook carries the reply the gate lets the change through, and the adapter says so (lacks)
a commit with no Waymark-Task trailer is sent back once, then goes through
a commit that carries the trailer is not touched
a shell command that names an existing secret-bearing file is denied
an edit of a secret-bearing file is denied
where a hook runs before the read tool, a read of a secret is denied
where nothing runs before the read, the end-of-turn hook finds it in the transcript and records it
a secret a tool printed is recorded by its kind, never by its value
the pack of a file reaches the agent with its first edit, once
the owner's procedures are handed with the first change and count as read
the user's answer to the choice window is recorded as the decision
the options are recorded with their label, recommended mark and risk
a task with a complete Cierre is recorded with its ID and files, not blocked
the record names the agent that closed it
the department and the skills come from the calls, whatever the agent's way to invoke a skill
a change closed with no Cierre is sent back and not recorded yet
sent back once, never twice: the second stop records what stayed open
a change with no gate run after it is sent back
a Q is no task: no ID and no T<n>
an L2 Cierre that leaves an item of the ask unanswered is sent back
a new session of the same project starts from the record of the last task
the next prompt is offered the next T<n> and the follow-up of the last
what the driver declares (reply, brake, pack) is what the adapter's own exports say
an agent's pre-tool payload maps to the files it edits or the command it runs
